therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: Ixazomib with Dexamethasone vs Ixazomib with Lenalidomide and Dexamethasone
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Multiple myeloma cell death and immune system modulation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Recurrent/refractory plasma cell myeloma patients with NFKB2 rearrangement stratification
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Overall response rate at 4 cycles (112 days) compared to historical control of 30%

subgroup_findings: NFKB2 rearrangement found in Arms B and C but not Arm A
Arm A showed best time to treatment failure at 24 months (50.5% vs 14.1% and 15.6%)
